decisions.reason: The superfood drink mix is a consumer side line far from the firm's announced waste-to-value technology direction and carries little sunk investment or public commitment, so management can let it go without having to justify earlier choices.

The modular plant extensions build directly on the established waste-to-energy offer and support the flagship plants, so the investment and the link to the firm's direction favour persisting with them.

WASTX Oil was launched publicly with a dated press release and presented as a flagship, so heavy engineering investment and visible commitment lead management to attribute weak results to temporary market conditions and keep it.

The plastic-to-fuel plant is a declared focus of the firm's direction and was raised to its own page in 2019, so sunk development costs and public commitment favour continuing despite uncertain results.
